value.rationale: This identifies a substantial geometric change in the polar map of a classical chordal cubic: generic degree 2 becomes 1 only in characteristic 3, while the projection center enters the Klein quadric and an isolated off-hypersurface base component appears. The structural explanation generalizes beyond an arbitrary point count and exposes a positive-characteristic gap in the explicitly characteristic-zero 2014 treatment.
